column1: # exam-grading local model registry (download manifest) -- read by pull.sh / verify.sh
# Tab separated. '#' lines are comments. One row per downloadable file.
#  1 id            registry model id (also the on-disk directory name)
#  3 component     model | mmproj                    (mmproj rows are optional)
#  4 repo          Hugging Face repo id (no endpoint prefix)
#  7 bytes         exact size in bytes (checked before hashing)
#  8 sha256        SHA-256 of the file (source: HF LFS ETag / x-linked-etag)
#  9 license       SPDX-ish id; must clear the whitelist in defaults.conf
# 10 support       verified | unverified  (llama.cpp compatibility, not legality)
# Weights are NEVER committed. Destination is the user data directory:
# Hashes captured 2026-11-02 from the Hugging Face API (x-linked-etag on the
# resolve URL). Re-check with scripts/model/verify.sh before trusting a file.
